headline: Fever and Lynx sweep into WNBA semifinals as Game 2 drama unfolds
whyCareReason: Caitlin Clark posted 24 points and 11 assists as Indiana swept Atlanta, while Napheesa Collier powered top-seeded Minnesota into the final four.
teaser: FINAL: Fever 87, Dream 81; Lynx 85, Mystics 73. Indiana and Minnesota punch semifinal tickets with 2-0 sweeps. Elimination night continues Wednesday for Aces and Liberty.
story:
Why this one matters: Tuesday night delivered the defining moments of the 2026 WNBA postseason opening round, and both road favorites refused to let their series reach a deciding third game.

In Atlanta, Caitlin Clark orchestrated another postseason masterclass, recording 24 points, 11 assists, and seven rebounds as the Indiana Fever held off a furious fourth-quarter charge from the Dream to secure an 87-81 victory at Gateway Center Arena. Kelsey Mitchell poured in 22 points, including back-to-back corner triples in the final two minutes, sending Indiana into the WNBA semifinals for the first time since 2015.

In Minneapolis, the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx left nothing to chance. Napheesa Collier dominated with 26 points and nine rebounds as Cheryl Reeve's squad dismantled the Washington Mystics 85-73. Both Indiana and Minnesota close out their series 2-0 and await their semifinal opponents.
stakes: Fever and Lynx become the first two teams to punch tickets to the 2026 WNBA semifinals.
rivalryAngle: Sudden-death playoff basketball: the Dream and Mystics fall as Indiana and Minnesota march forward.
